one_off_commands_note: These are one-shot artisan commands used during specific cycles (menu heals, e2e seeding, login fixtures). They have signatures so they auto-load. Owner mandate KEEP what works — none of them run automatically, so they sit at zero cost. Removing them is purely cosmetic; would lose audit trail. Recommend leave as-is unless explicit cleanup sprint.
note_on_models_addon_customer_notificati: App\Models\Addon, Customer, Notification show no static references but Eloquent uses dynamic relation resolution and morphTo polymorphism. Customer is a User subtype (NFC loyalty alias on the users table). Notification probably tied to legacy notifications table from the StarterKit upstream.
